   ```

         Done when: a pooled fit gives a closure curve for each of the 14 locks
   - [ ] Closure-history map for boat operators (O4)
         Size: about a day; one static map page
         Done when: operators can open a map of each lock's closure history
   ```

5. Commit on `main`:
   `git add specs/lock-closures-roadmap.md specs/deferred_items.md && git commit -m "lock-closures roadmap: stop Track A, park O2–O4"`
